run_detect_text_cli: run detect_text_cli to detect bounding boxes in images or PDFs from an input path
create_detection_predictor: create a DetectionPredictor instance to detect text bounding boxes in a list of PIL images
build_cliloader: build a CLILoader to load images from a file or folder with optional page range filtering
test_parse_range_str: test CLILoader.parse_range_str to parse comma-separated page ranges like '0,5-10,20' into a list of integers
summarize_draw_polys_on_image: summarize draw_polys_on_image to draw detected bounding box polygons onto an image for visualization
